cues.text: A back alley behind Port Island Station, with bins along a wall and a flight of concrete steps. Rough-looking teenagers hang around in small groups. You, Yukari and Junpei walk in among them, and the nearest ones turn to look.
Two young men, one in a tracksuit, one in a black T-shirt, walk over from the steps and plant themselves in front of you.
The one in the black T-shirt drives a fist into Junpei's stomach. Junpei doubles over and sinks into a crouch.
Yukari drops to her knees beside Junpei. The one in the tracksuit points at them and calls to the others.
A tall young man in a long coat and a beanie has walked up behind the punks and stands facing them.
The punk squares up to him, but the young man hits him first. The punk staggers back and drops to one knee.
The punk and his friend back away and hurry off. Yukari gets up, and Junpei slowly straightens and turns to the young man.
Shinjiro, who had turned away to leave, stops and turns back toward Yukari.
Shinjiro turns his back, hands in his pockets, and walks away down the alley.
